Thanks for the ping, Sarah — and thanks for looping us in.

Proposed approach ("Interviewer Swivel & Exchange Protocol") — concise plan so we can move fast:

1) Swap-first: we attempt panel swaps among confirmed interviewers in the same functional area (security ↔ security, infra ↔ infra) to keep context continuity.
2) Float backstop: if a one-to-one swap isn't available, deploy a named float interviewer from the on-call interviewing pool (primary/secondary). Primary covers the live slot; secondary is shadow-ready to jump in if the primary gets pulled.
3) Debrief split: keep the hiring manager + one technical senior for the debrief; float acts as note-taker if debrief headcount falls below 3.
4) Timezone wedge: cover the 13:00–14:00 PT slot with an EU-friendly interviewer (rotate from the 08:00–12:00 PT volunteers).

Operational asks for internal folks:
- Monica: can you take the 13:00–14:00 PT slot if needed (you'd be EU-friendly)?
- Marissa: please confirm if you can float primary/secondary for either security or infra (we may split duties).
- Jonas: if we proceed, can you publish an updated panel_schedule.ics and mark the candidate loop as high-priority so calendar auto-accepts the float assignment?

I'll attach a draft calendar (.ics) and the resume I was sent. If everyone confirms, I'll reply-all with the final assignments and include the candidate packet + short interviewer prep notes.

— Sergio Alvarez
